description: The x-axis of the plot represents the step number, ranging from 0 to 60000. The y-axis represents the accuracy of the next token prediction, ranging from 0.10 to 0.40. The plot shows two lines, one for Ex1 Accuracy and one for Ex2 Accuracy. The Ex1 Accuracy line starts at 0.10 and increases to 0.40, while the Ex2 Accuracy line starts at 0.10 and increases to 0.39. The Ex1 Accuracy line is blue and the Ex2 Accuracy line is green. Both lines show a steady increase in accuracy as the step number increases.
